title: Mary Seacole's British Hotel in the Crimea
summary: Jamaican nurse and businesswoman Mary Seacole set up the British Hotel near the front to feed and care for sick and convalescent officers in the Crimean War.
why: A self-funded hotel and canteen for officers near the Crimean front.

notes.problem: Source reports critics (Lynn McDonald, Nightingale Society) arguing 'Seacole's role in the Crimean War was overplayed'; the venture became mainly food and drink.

unsung.contribution: Nursed and supplied soldiers in the Crimean War from her self-funded British Hotel.
unsung.recognition: Famous in her day, she was largely forgotten for almost a century after her death.
